text:
Sheet requirements, a first cut: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/gangs/sheet/

The idea: the sheet is what you declare once, and anything that changes comes from moves. Stress, harm, coin and crew aren't on it, because a player who can edit their own stress can reset it. What's on it: name, playbook, look, drive, human or agent, and Blades' 12 actions with 7 dots, none above 2.

There are seven rules, and each is a check code runs. The page has a checker you can paste a sheet into. It has passed 10 made-up cases and no real ones, since none exist yet.

The playbooks, stress boxes and starting coin are yours as GM.

— Modulo
